name: SolarFarmPerformanceMonitor
tagline: Run your PV fleet on PR, availability and MWh lost – alarms, O&M work and cleaning in one app.
description: A complete solar farm performance and O&M app for IPPs, asset managers and O&M contractors: plants, blocks and inverters with performance ratio and performance index against expected energy; time-based availability with excluded causes; lost energy and revenue; live production loss of every open alarm; string monitoring; O&M tickets with fault codes, priorities and safety lock-out; remote diagnosis with an attempt limit; dispatch with capacity, HV authorisation and SLA checks; parts, resolution and a production check before closing; planned outages; soiling and cleaning economics with payback and crew bookings; work order, performance, cleaning and summary outputs for Power Automate.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 68 MWp, 41-inverter portfolio
PR (kWp × POA) and PI (actual ÷ expected) per inverter, block, plant and fleet
Lost energy and revenue at your tariff
Live MWh/day loss per open alarm
Fault codes with priority, cause, loss share and safety lock-out
Dispatch with capacity, HV authorisation and SLA check
Parts with ETA vs SLA and loss until then
Soiling and cleaning payback, crew booking, cleaning done
Bulk remote command, dispatch, cleaning, report, export
Work order, performance, cleaning, CSV and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set SolarFarmPerformanceMonitor + Power Pages field control SolarFarmPerformanceMonitorPortal, shared src/app)
